originalPrompt: Cinematic low-key film noir medium close-up of a detective standing beside a Venetian-blinded window in a dark office at night. Sharp, high-contrast slivers of neon blue and amber streetlight slice across his face and trench coat. Heavy rain streaks run down the glass. The detective slowly strikes a wooden match, creating a sudden warm amber glow that illuminates his eyes and casts crisp shifting shadows across the wall behind him. Soft drifting match smoke.
